positiveFlows.title: PURPOSE:  THIS APPLICATION REQUESTS CANCER RESEARCH EQUIPMENT FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS:  MICROSCOPIC IMAGING; LEAD DEVELOPMENT OPTIMIZATION; TRANSGENIC AND GENE TARGETING; CRYO-ELECTRON MICROSOPY & DNA REPAIR; CANCER PATHOLOGY SCANNING; CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY; METABOLIC NUTRITION; AND ESSENTIAL BASIC SCIENCE.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED:  KUCC WILL PROCURE $5.0 MILLION IN NEW EQUIPMENT TO REFRESH THE SHARED USE LABORATORIES SUPPORTING THE CANCER CENTER'S THREE RESEARCH PROGRAMS:  CANCER BIOLOGY; CANCER PREVENTION AND CONTROL; AND DRUG DISCOVERY, DELIVERY, AND EXPERIMENTAL THERAPEUTICS.EXPECTED OUTCOMES:  THESE NEW INSTRUMENTS WILL HELP PROVIDE THE OPTIMAL ENVIRONMENT TO FOCUS THE POWER OF PRECISION MEDICINE, BASIC SCIENCE INQUIRY, DRUG DISCOVERY AND DEVELOPMENT, AND BEHAVIORAL INTERVENTIONS TO DECREASE CANCER INCIDENCE, MORBIDITY, AND MORTALITY. INTENDED BENEFICIARIES:  RESIDENTS OF THE STATE OF KANSAS (105 COUNTIES) AS WELL AS THE 18 NEIGHBORING COUNTIES OF WESTERN MISSOURI WILL BENEFIT FROM THE ENHANCED RESEARCH MADE POSSIBLE BY THE INVESTMENT IN THIS EQUIPMENT.  THESE RESIDENTS ARE SERVED BY KUCC, AS IT IS THE ONLY ACADEMIC CANCER CENTER IN THIS REGION.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES:  NO SUBAWARDS WITH THIS APPLICATION.

positiveFlows.title: PURPOSE:  ESTABLISH AN ACCREDITED OCEANOGRAPHIC CALIBRATION LABORATORY ON THE GULF TO STRATEGICALLY IMPROVE DATA EFFICACY FOR INDUSTRY, ACADEMIA, AND US GOVERNMENT INTERESTS.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED:  DESIGN AND ESTABLISH A CALIBRATION FACILITY INCLUSIVE OF CALIBRATION INSTRUMENTS, STANDARDS, SUPPORT EQUIPMENT AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROLS. ACQUIRE AND INSTALL NECESSARY EQUIPMENT AND TRAIN STAFF TO WORK WITH THE EQUIPMENTS.EXPECTED OUTCOMES:  THIS PROPOSED FACILITY WILL SERVE THE U.S. RESEARCH, DEFENSE, AND MARINE OPERATIONS COMMUNITIES WITH HIGH QUALITY AND RAPID RE-CALIBRATION SERVICES. POSITIVE IMPACTS ARE EXPECTED FOR RESEARCH, NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, SHIPPING OPERATIONS AND DEFENSE OPERATIONS.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES:  NIST:  ESTABLISHING AN ACCREDITED OCEANOGRAPHIC CALIBRATION LABORATORY ON THE GULF WILL STRATEGICALLY IMPROVE DATA EFFICACY FOR INDUSTRY, ACADEMIA, AND US GOVERNMENT INTERESTS, INCLUDING THOSE OF NIST.  MISSISSIPPI:  NIST CERTIFIED CALIBRATION SERVICES ARE IN HIGH DEMAND RELATIVE TO THEIR AVAILABILITY. A LAB IN MISSISSIPPI WOULD BE STRATEGIC NOT ONLY FOR MISSISSIPPI, BUT ALSO FOR ATTRACTING BUSINESS THROUGHOUT THE SOUTHEAST UNITED STATES.  PUBLIC:    AN ACCREDITED OCEANOGRAPHIC CALIBRATION LABORATORY WHICH WOULD AID IN QUICKER RE-CALIBRATION AND MAINTENANCE OF OCEANOGRAPHIC SENSORS WOULD BENEFIT ACTIVITIES IN RESEARCH, NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, SHIPPING OPERATIONS AND DEFENSE OPERATIONS.  SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES:  THE RECIPIENT DOES INTEND TO SUBAWARD FUNDS.

PURPOSE: THIS PROJECT WILL DEVELOP AND TEST A FRAMEWORK FOR HARMONIZING UAS TRAINING AND CREDENTIALING SERVICES. THIS WILL BE APPLIED TO BOTH OPERATORS AND SYSTEMS, AND SCALE TO COVER FEDERAL, STATE, AND LOCAL NEEDS.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: THIS PROJECT WILL CONSIST OF THREE MAIN, INTERDEPENDENT TASKS: 1) STAFFING, 2) TECHNOLOGY, AND 3) INSTRUCTION. THE STAFFING TASK WILL CENTER ON PROVIDING THE HUMAN RESOURCES NEEDED TO PROVIDE LEADERSHIP, OVERSIGHT, AND SUPPORT. THE TECHNOLOGY TASK WILL FOCUS ON PROCURING THE UAS TECHNOLOGY, VIRTUAL TECHNOLOGY, AND LEARNING MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS INFRASTRUCTURE NEEDED TO DELIVER THE TRAINING. THE INSTRUCTION TASK WILL BUILD OUT A NETWORK OF NATIONALLY RECOGNIZED UAS EXPERTS TO DESIGN AND DELIVER THE TRAINING.EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THIS PROJECT WILL IMPROVE THE ABILITY OF FIRST RESPONDERS TO SAFELY INTEGRATE UAS INTO OPERATIONS AT PACE WITH THE WIDE ARRAY OF EVER-EVOLVING TECHNOLOGY TRANSFORMING HOW FEDERAL, STATE, AND LOCAL ENTITIES CONDUCT OPERATIONS WHILE CONCURRENTLY IMPROVING TRUST BETWEEN COLLABORATING AGENCIES AND THE PUBLIC.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: FIRST RESPONDERS ARE THE PRIMARY INTENDED BENEFICIARIES.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: NO SUBRECIPIENT IS IDENTIFIED.

PURPOSE: THE PURPOSE OF THIS GRANT IS TO EXPAND THE NATIONAL CENTER FOR ADVANCED MATERIALS PERFORMANCE (NCAMP) QUALIFICATIONS FRAMEWORK FOR MANUFACTURING MATERIALS AND PROCESSES.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: THE PURCHASE, INSTALLATION, AND REQUIRED TRAINING FOR THE RPMI STANDARD 557XR WITH 4KW FIBER LASER WILL OCCUR. ADDITIONALLY, A GROUP OF SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTS WILL SERVE AS A STEERING COMMITTEE AND ASSIST IN THE CREATION OF AN INITIAL FRAMEWORK FOR THE DED PROCESS. EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THE ACQUISITION OF THE RPMI STANDARD 557XR WITH 4KW FIBER LASER WILL ALLOW FOR FUTURE INNOVATION AND EXTEND LAB CAPABILITIES AND IMPROVED QUALIFICATION DATABASES, SPECIFICATIONS, AND EQUIVALENCY PROTOCOLS IN INDUSTRY.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: NCAMP AND IT?S PARTNERS WOULD DIRECTLY BENEFIT FROM THE EXPANSION OF CURRENT CAPABILITIES. THIS WOULD IN TURN HELP TO EXPEDITE THE ADAPTATION OF ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING PROCESSES AND STANDARDS WHICH WILL BENEFIT INDUSTRY AND ULTIMATELY THE GENERAL PUBLIC. SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: THE ONLY CONTRACTUAL OBLIGATION IS WITH THE MANUFACTURER OF THE RPMI STANDARD 557XR WITH 4KW FIBER LASER FOR THE PURCHASE, INSTALLATION, AND TRAINING FOR PROPER OPERATION OF THE EQUIPMENT.

PURPOSE:  CREATE THE UNIVERSITY OF DELAWARE (UD) PROCESS DEVELOPMENT TESTBED WITH RELEVANT EQUIPMENT TO FACILITATE PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS, WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT, AND THE TESTING AND DEMONSTRATION OF BIOPHARMACEUTICAL INNOVATIONS. THIS FACILITY WILL LEVERAGE THE KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE OF THE NIIMBL, A PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP FOCUSED ON THE ACCELERATION OF THE BIOPHARMACEUTICAL INNOVATION. ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED:  THIS PROJECT WILL PROCURE AND INSTALL EQUIPMENT FOR UD PROCESS DEVELOPMENT TESTBED THAT WILL SERVE AS A SCALE-DOWN MODEL OF THE NIIMBL PROCESS INTENSIFICATION TESTBED.  PHASE 1 WILL INCLUDE FINALIZING DETAILS, SPECIFICATIONS, AND RECEIVE NECESSARY QUOTATIONS FOR EQUIPMENT. IN PHASE 2, THEY WILL PROCURE AND INSTALL EQUIPMENT, AND PERFORM SITE ACCEPTANCE TESTING.EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THE UD PROCESS DEVELOPMENT TESTBED WILL ALLOW SMALLER SCALE, MORE RAPID, AND MORE AFFORDABLE BIOPHARMACEUTICAL EXPERIMENTS TO BE PERFORMED.  THE TESTBED WILL ENABLE WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT AND TRAINING, DATA TO BE COLLECTED AND USED IN PROCESS MODELS BEING DEVELOPED IN THE NIIMBL BIG DATA PROGRAM, AND NEW MATERIALS (HARVEST CELL CULTURE FLUID, CHROMATOGRAPHY ELUATES, ETC.) PRODUCED THAT CAN BE SHARED WITH THE BIOPHARMACEUTICAL MANUFACTURING INNOVATION COMMUNITY. INTENDED BENEFICIARIES:1. TO NIST: THE WORK PLANS ALIGN WITH NIST'S MANUFACTURING MISSION SPACE FOR BOTH ADVANCED MANUFACTURING TECHNOLOGY AND SUPPLY CHAIN SECURITY.  NIST STAFF CAN LEVERAGE THIS PROJECT TO FURTHER THE IMPACT OF OUR TECHNICAL EXPERTISE IN BIOMANUFACTURING, SPECIFICALLY THE ONGOING DEVELOPMENT OF THE RESEARCH GRADE REFERENCE CELL-LINE EXPRESSING THE NIST-MAB TO FOSTER INNOVATION BIOPHARMACEUTICAL MANUFACTURING. THE PROJECT ALSO LEVERAGES NIST'S INVESTMENT IN NIIMBL. 2. TO AWARDEE: THE UNIVERSITY OF DELAWARE, AS THE LEAD OF THE NIIMBL CONSORTIUM, WILL BE ABLE TO ESTABLISH A MORE COST-EFFICIENT CAPABILITY TO DO SMALL SCALE BIOPHARMA PROCESS-DEVELOPMENT WORK ON INDUSTRIALLY RELEVANT EQUIPMENT TO PREPARE FOR RUNS OF THE NIIMBL PROCESS INTENSIFICATION TEST BED. 3. TO THE NATION: THE PANDEMIC HAS FULLY REVEALED THE IMPORTANCE OF AN AGILE DOMESTIC CAPACITY FOR PRODUCTION OF BIOMANUFACTURED THERAPIES SUCH AS VACCINES.  THE UNIVERSITY OF DELAWARE'S LEADERSHIP OF THE NIIMBL PARTNERSHIP SUPPORTS THE COLLABORATIVE DEVELOPMENT OF THE NEXT GENERATION PROCESSES FOR MANUFACTURING THESE CRITICAL PRODUCTS.  THIS FUNDING WILL ENABLE NIIMBL TO PROVIDE AN OPEN COLLABORATION RESOURCE FOR THE US BIOECONOMY THAT WILL AID IN DEVELOPING NEW TECHNOLOGIES TO SUPPORT FASTER TO MARKET, HIGHER QUALITY AND EXTENDED SUPPLY AND AVAILABILITY OF DRUG PRODUCTS.  SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES:NO SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES WILL BE INVOLVED WITH THIS GRANT.

PURPOSE: THE PURPOSE OF THIS GRANT IS TO CREATE A CENTER FOR COMMERCIALIZATION LINKED TO THE NATIONAL INSTITUTE FOR MATERIALS ADVANCEMENT AT PITTSBURG STATE UNIVERSITY.  ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: THE CENTRAL GOAL OF THE CENTER IS TO USE RESEARCH AND PARTNERED RESEARCH TO DEVELOP PRODUCTS CAPABLE OF BEING DELIVERED TO MARKET AND TO COMMERCIALIZE SAID PRODUCTS. OVER THE COURSE OF THE THREE YEARS OF THIS PROPOSED PROJECT, THE CENTER FOR COMMERCIALIZATION WILL BE ESTABLISHED, STAFFED, AND EQUIPPED TO CREATE RESEARCH-TO-MARKET PRODUCTS. PURPOSE:THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS TO LEVERAGE THE EXISTING UNIVERSITY OF NEW MEXICO DECEDENT IMAGE DATABASE TO IMPROVE METHODOLOGY USED TO ESTIMATE DEMOGRAPHIC PARAMETERS IN UNKNOWN HUMAN SKELETAL REMAINS, REFERRED TO AS THE FORENSIC BIOLOGICAL ANTHROPOLOGICAL PROFILE.  THE APPLICANT WILL APPLY NEW MACHINE LEARNING METHODS TO IMPROVE THE ESTIMATION OF POPULATION AFFINITY, STATURE (HEIGHT), AND AGE FOR AMERICAN INDIANS (AI) AND HISPANIC/LATINX AMERICANS (HLA).ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED:THE RECIPIENT WILL COLLECT SKELETAL METRIC DATA FROM VIRTUAL OSTEOLOGICAL SAMPLES IN THE FORM OF COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY (CT) SCANS, OF KNOWN INDIVIDUALS TO BUILD A DATABASE FOR COMPARISON WITH UNKNOWN INDIVIDUALS.  THIS DATA WILL BE PROVIDED TO THE FORENSIC DATABANK, A PRE-EXISTING RESOURCE FOR FORENSIC ANTHROPOLOGY, WHICH WILL MAKE THE DATA AVAILABLE TO THE RESEARCH PUBLIC.  THE RECIPIENT WILL DEVELOP EQUATIONS TO IMPROVE ESTIMATIONS OF STATURE OF UNIDENTIFIED HUMAN REMAINS FROM SEVERAL AMERICAN SUBGROUPS AND USE 3D DATA FROM CT SCANS TO PIONEER NEW METHODS OF AGE ESTIMATION FROM WRIST BONES.  THE RECIPIENT WILL ALSO DEVELOP AND MAKE AVAILABLE TO THE RESEARCH PUBLIC A NEW TOOL FOR ESTIMATING POPULATION AFFINITY OF UNKNOWN HUMAN REMAINS USING DENTAL MORPHOLOGICAL CHARACTERISTICS. THE RECIPIENT WILL ALSO MOVE THIS RESEARCH INTO PRACTICE BY CONDUCTING FORENSIC ANTHROPOLOGICAL ANALYSES TO IMPROVE IDENTIFICATION OF UNIDENTIFIED HUMAN REMAINS IN NEW MEXICO AND OTHER JURISDICTIONS.EXPECTED OUTCOMES:THE RESEARCH EFFORTS WILL MOVE THE FIELD OF FORENSIC ANTHROPOLOGY FORWARD BY DEVELOPING METHODS TO IMPROVE THE ESTIMATION OF POPULATION AFFINITY, STATURE (HEIGHT), AND AGE FOR AMERICAN INDIANS (AI) AND HISPANIC/LATINX AMERICANS (HLA). THIS ALLOWS FORENSIC ANTHROPOLOGISTS TO BETTER CHARACTERIZE AND ASSOCIATE SKELETAL REMAINS WITH THE PROPER POPULATION AFFINITY AND TO ULTIMATELY BRING AN IDENTIFY TO THE SKELETAL REMAINS.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES:THIS PROJECT WILL ADDRESS ONE COMPONENT OF THE ONGOING NATIONAL CHALLENGE OF MISSING AND MURDERED AMERICAN INDIANS.  THIS PROJECT BENEFITS FORENSIC ANTHOLOGISTS, MEDICAL EXAMINERS, CORONERS, LAW ENFORCEMENT AND ULTIMATELY FAMILIES OF MISSING INDIVIDUALS. SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES:NO SUBAWARDS WITH THIS APPLICATION.

EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THE ACQUISITION OF THE MANUFACTURING TECHNOLOGY SUPPORTING COLD SPRAY WILL ENHANCE THE AAM CENTER'S CAPABILITIES TO CONDUCT INDUSTRY-DRIVEN/USE-INSPIRED RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT AND PROVIDE WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: NORTHEASTERN UNIVERSITY'S ROUX INSTITUTE AND KOSTAS RESEARCH INSTITUTE WOULD DIRECTLY BENEFIT FROM THE EXPANSION OF THE AAM CENTER IN BRUNSWICK LANDING. PURPOSE: MOUNTWEST COMMUNITY AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE SEEKS TO BECOME DESIGNATED AS A NATIONAL CENTER OF ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE IN CYBERSECURITY (NCAE-C) BY THE NATIONAL SECURITY AGENCY AND IMPLEMENT AN ON-CAMPUS CYBERSECURITY CENTER TO ADDRESS BOTH WEST VIRGINIA AND NATIONAL INTERESTS OF CYBERSECURITY.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: THIS PROJECT WILL STRENGTHEN OF THE CYBERSECURITY CURRICULUM AND THE SUPPORTING TECHNOLOGY. IT WILL ALSO BE NECESSARY TO UPDATE AND STRENGTHEN THE COLLEGEWIDE INFORMATION ASSURANCE AND SECURITY PLAN TO OPERATE AND ALIGN WITH CENTER OF ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE PRACTICES. THE COLLEGE WILL DESIGNATE SPACE ON CAMPUS TO SERVE AS THE PHYSICAL SPACE FOR THE CENTER. DURING THIS PROJECT, IT PROGRAMS SUCH AS THE NETWORK ADMINISTRATIONS PROGRAM, CYBERSECURITY PROGRAM, AND OTHER RELATED IT CLASSROOMS WILL MOVE TO INCREASE SPACE AND OPERATE MORE EFFICIENTLY. THROUGH THIS PROCESS, THE COLLEGE WILL ALSO OBTAIN CERTIFICATION FROM EC-COUNCIL (INTERNATIONAL COUNCIL OF E-COMMERCE) AND WILL PROVIDE EC-COUNCIL TRAININGS AND CERTIFICATIONS TO LOCAL BUSINESS AND INDUSTRY. THE CENTER WILL HOST NON-CREDIT TRAININGS, SHORT-TERM CERTIFICATIONS, AND MICRO-CREDENTIALS FOR BOTH BUSINESS AND INDUSTRY AND THE IT WORKFORCE LOOKING TO UPSKILL OR RESKILL. THE CENTER WILL ALSO HOUSE STATIONS FOR ETHICAL HACKING TEAM EXERCISES.  THE COLLEGE WILL HIRE A PROGRAM DIRECTOR FOR THE CENTER OF ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE.EXPECTED OUTCOMES: INCREASE THE NUMBER OF GRADUATES BY 25% INTO THE INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY FIELD, WITH EITHER A CYBERSECURITY DEGREE OR ENHANCED EMPHASIS IN CYBERSECURITY. INCREASE SECURITY-RELATED SIMULATION SO GRADUATES ARE MORE PREPARED FOR THE WORKFORCE. INCREASE OUTREACH TO K-12 SCHOOLS, LOW-INCOME YOUNG WOMEN, RURAL APPALACHIANS, AND FIRST-GENERATION STUDENTS. EMPOWER STUDENTS, FACULTY, AND OTHER MEMBERS OF THE COLLEGE TO ENGAGE IN INTERDISCIPLINARY THOUGHT, APPLICATION, AND LEADERSHIP IN?CYBERSECURITY. ENHANCE IT PROGRAM OFFERINGS BY PURCHASING INDUSTRY-STANDARD EQUIPMENT AND PROVIDING MORE HANDS-ON TRAINING ON EQUIPMENT. INCREASE EMPLOYER SATISFACTION WITH PLACEMENT OF STUDENTS WHO ARE CAREER READY AND BETTER EQUIPPED TO PROVIDE CYBERSECURITY SOLUTION TO EMPLOYERS UPON GRADUATION. INCREASE RETENTION RATE AND COMPLETION OF CERTIFICATES OR DEGREES BY 25% INCREASE THE NUMBER OF SHORT-TERM TRAININGS AND MICRO-CREDENTIALS OFFERED BY 25% OBTAIN THE NCAE-C DESIGNATION. CREATE A PHYSICAL CYBERSECURITY CENTER. OBTAIN EC COUNCIL CERTIFICATION PROJECT MANAGEMENTINTENDED BENEFICIARIES: EMPLOYERS IN THE LOCAL COMMUNITY AND ACROSS THE NATION, STUDENTS OR LEARNERS WHO WILL BE PREPARED FOR GOOD JOBS, AND FACULTY WHO CAN DEEPEN THEIR EXPERTISE AND SKILLS IN CYBERSECURITY.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: THERE ARE NO PLANNED SUBAWARDS.

AWARD DESCRIPTION PURPOSE:THE PURPOSE OF THIS PROJECT IS THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SMART TECHNOLOGY LAB ENABLING ADVANCES IN INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGIES RANGING FROM SMART GRID AND UNCREWED AERIAL SYSTEMS (UAS) TO AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES AND ROBOTIC MANUFACTURING SYSTEMS.ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED:THE RESEARCHERS WILL DEVELOP AGILE STANDARDS-BASED RESEARCH INFRASTRUCTURE, INCLUDING ADVANCED COMMUNICATIONS AND COMPUTATIONAL CAPABILITIES, TO SUPPORT EXPERIMENTS IN THE APPLICATION OF INTERNET OF THINGS CONCEPTS TO CITY AND COMMUNITY SYSTEMS, SUPPLY CHAIN AND TRANSPORT SYSTEMS, MANUFACTURING, AND ENERGY INFRASTRUCTURE. EXPECTED OUTCOMES:THE RESULTS OF RESEARCH IN THE PLANNED SMART TECHNOLOGY LAB ARE EXPECTED TO ADVANCE THE NATION'S GOALS FOR CLEAN AND EFFICIENT ENERGY SYSTEMS THROUGH SMART GRID CONCEPTS, VIBRANT COMMUNITIES APPLYING NEW SMART CITY TECHNOLOGIES, AND A GLOBALLY COMPETITIVE U.S. MANUFACTURING SECTOR THROUGH INTELLIGENT CONTROL SYSTEMS AND ADVANCED ROBOTICS.INTENDED BENEFICIARIES:U.S. MANUFACTURING, ENERGY, AND TRANSPORT SECTORS; AND RESEARCHERS AND STUDENTS IN THE NORTHEAST ACADEMIC AND INDUSTRIAL COMMUNITIES.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES:THE RECIPIENT DOES NOT INTEND TO SUBAWARD FUNDS.

positiveFlows.title: PURPOSE: THE PURPOSE OF THIS GRANT IS TO PURCHASE ANALYTICAL EQUIPMENT FOR MEASUREMENT SCIENCE.  FUNDS WILL BE USED TO PURCHASE (1) MICROFOCUS COMPUTER TOMOGRAPHY SYSTEM $495,000; (2) INDUCTIVELY-COUPLED PLASMA MASS SPECTROMETRY SYSTEM $163,000; (3) MATRIX-ASSISTED LASER DESORPTION/IONIZATION MASS SPECTROSCOPY SYSTEM $183,000; (4) SIZE-EXCLUSION CHROMATOGRAPHY/GEL PERMEATION CHROMATOGRAPH $86,000; (5) MICRO-ANALYTICAL BALANCE $36,000.  TOTAL EXPENDITURES ARE $963,000. ACTIVITIES TO BE PERFORMED: FIVE ANALYTICAL INSTRUMENTS WILL BE PURCHASED THROUGH THE UNIVERSITY'S COMPETITIVE BIDDING SYSTEM. EXPECTED OUTCOMES: THE INSTRUMENTS WILL SUPPORT THE UNIVERSITY'S INTERDISCIPLINARY PROGRAMS RELATED TO ENVIRONMENTAL, SUSTAINABILITY, AND ANTHROPOLOGICAL RESEARCH. INTENDED BENEFICIARIES: THE INSTRUMENTS WILL BE USED BY UST PROFESSORS, RESEARCH STAFF AND STUDENTS.  THE EQUIPMENT WILL PROVIDE TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES FOR UNDERGRADUATES AS PART OF THE INTERDISCIPLINARY SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, ENGINEERING, ARTS, AND MATHEMATICS (STEAM).  UST ALSO MAINTAINS COLLABORATIONS WITH LOCAL COMMUNITY PARTNERS, SUCH AS THE SCIENCE MUSEUM OF MINNESOTA, WHICH WILL BENEFIT FROM THE ADDED CAPABILITIES PROVIDED BY THE INSTRUMENTS.SUBRECIPIENT ACTIVITIES: N/A
